name: set-stack
instr:
I'm working in our vendored copy of hashicorp's go-set, and the sorted-set side of it is broken: `TreeSet` is how we keep ordered, deduplicated collections, and most of its set operations (slicing by bound, union/intersect/difference, equality, string output, iteration, JSON) currently panic with "not implemented". The same goes for the slice/set helpers at the bottom of `collection.go` and the JSON methods `Set.MarshalJSON`, `HashSet.MarshalJSON` and `HashSet.UnmarshalJSON`.

Could you implement them? The stubs are in `treeset.go`, `collection.go`, `hashset.go` and `set.go`, all in the root `set` package.

The doc comments on those functions, plus the TreeSet section of the readme, are the contract, so please follow them closely; other code of ours relies on the ordering and the return values they describe.

Please keep every exported name and signature as it is, and feel free to add private helpers where you need them. I'll run the package's own tests against it, and everything else in the module's tests has to keep passing too.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages, cgo, and `//go:linkname` or `//go:embed` directives; `os.Exit`, `os.StartProcess`, `os.FindProcess` and `runtime.Goexit`; reading `os.Args`, `os.Executable`, `/proc/self` or `runtime/debug` build info; caller or stack lookups
